text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
Tap Dance City, claiming she hadn't had enough fun yet, brought me to—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Playing games like this is nice once in a while, right?
Now then, darts or billiards—
which one should we start with, I wonder~."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Sirius and Nakayama!
Why don't you guys join in too? Come on, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
How nice that you brought a chaperone along, Tap.
Are you looking to play house?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"No way! Trainer is a dependable partner.
And a romantic, just like me!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Care to partake in a banquet of ours like that?
What do you say, Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I want no part in half-hearted matches.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's settle this with darts!
We'll do a doubles Count-Up match!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: A simple contest to see which team scores more points—sounds neat, right? We'll give you a grand welcome!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll go first.
Come on, let's have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Take that!

Although the three darts she threw scattered across
different parts of the board, she scored a fairly decent score!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nice! A great start!
Now, you guys are next! How are you gonna liven things up?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah. I'm only interested in high-risk,
high-score spots.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Gambler.
Just make sure you don't drag me down, got it?

I can feel an incredible intensity.
I need to be careful not to miss any shots
so I don't get left behind in the match.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! A bullseye!!
Widened the gap again, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad, Sirius!
Though the tougher you are, the more fired up I get!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer, your turn next!
The match is just getting started! Let's hype it up!

Should I take the risk and aim for high points in a single comeback move...?
Or should I steadily rack up points so I don't fall behind...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't think!
Just have fun!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your shoulders are way too tense.
Just enjoy the darts... that's all there is to it!

I didn't realize how stiff I was until she spoke to me.
I would have definitely mishit that shot...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Good.
Let 'em have it.

(Gah!)
(Gah!!)
(Gah!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nice grouping! Way to go!!
A massive comeback with all triple 20s!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama & Sirius
text_block_list.text: What!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's it, Trainer!
Don't go forgetting that sensation now!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's run away with the lead all the way to the end!
Let's keep this party going!!
"It turned into a close battle as the opponent closed in, but she managed to hold the lead and seize victory!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeesss!!
Well done, matey!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, good grief...
You really outdid yourself, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Hah! Wasn't boring at all.
We got quite the surprise, after all."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Right? She's my prized right hand!
I'm so glad you guys understand!
choice_data_list: Relaxing your shoulders really is important!
Relaxing your shoulders really is important, huh!
Thanks to Tap, I had a great time!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Right? She's my prized right hand!
I'm so glad you guys understand!
choice_data_list: Relaxing your shoulders really is important!
Relaxing your shoulders really is important, huh!
Thanks to Tap, I had a great time!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's right! If you don't enjoy yourself, nothing will ever start!
The results will follow naturally!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, you get it, don'tcha? A gamble ain't worth a damn without the thrill of putting it all on the line.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
When there's a massive treasure ahead, even a storm is just an opening act!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I was deeply moved by your performance!
A come-from-behind victory is the very soul of romance, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're satisfied,
Mr. Romantic.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: My right hand is bound to dazzle us even more! Come on, come on! Let's keep the feast going!
